# nursery v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Supervise your children in the appropriate environment

## Modules

- [Nursery](https://nursery.hexdocs.pm/Nursery.md): The `Nursery` module provides functionality for setting up a supervisor
with child processes filtered by environment.
- [Nursery.Utils](https://nursery.hexdocs.pm/Nursery.Utils.md): The `Nursery.Utils` module provides utility functions for filtering
child process specifications based on the environment.
